title: Torsion and vanishing properties of the cohomology of the extended alternating Cech complex
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects four properties of the cohomology modules of the extended alternating Cech complex: vanishing outside the range of degrees, annihilation of every class by a power of each element, support inside the closed set defined by the ideal generated by the elements, and vanishing when one element of the ideal acts invertibly on the module. The proof is an 18-line argument that runs through localisation: after the degree range is read off from the shape of the complex, the annihilation statement is reduced to the vanishing of the localised cohomology, which by the base change statement of the same block is the extended alternating complex of the localised module over the localised ring, and that vanishing is supplied by the homotopy statement already proved; the support statement follows from the same local vanishing, and the last part combines invertibility of the action with the support containment. Three of the four parts are therefore corollaries of the two neighbouring statements of the block, each of which this lane has registered separately.
